entities.name: RimM ribosome maturation factor
observations: The 173-residue query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt entry A6Q550 from Nitratiruptor sp. SB155-2.
RimM is a cytoplasmic accessory factor required for efficient 30S ribosomal-subunit assembly and 16S rRNA processing.
RimM may act during final 30S-subunit/head assembly and may function before and after RbfA.
RimM binds free 30S subunits rather than 70S ribosomes and binds ribosomal protein uS19.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular mass 19,656 Da, theoretical pI 5.04, predicted charge at pH 7 approximately -7.2, GRAVY -0.409, instability index 31.9.
Pfam evidence identifies an N-terminal RimM domain (PF01782; residues 4-80) and a C-terminal PRC/RimM-associated domain (PF05239 and PF24986; approximately residues 90-168).
No explicit catalytic reaction or cofactor annotation was retrieved; the protein is best regarded as a non-enzymatic ribosome biogenesis factor.

entities.name: 30S ribosomal subunit biogenesis
observations: RimM participates in bacterial small-subunit assembly and 16S rRNA maturation.

entities.name: uS19 ribosomal protein
observations: RimM is annotated to bind ribosomal protein uS19 during small-subunit maturation.
